items.title: Octopus: One Brain, Many Branches for Latent-KV Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: Octopus：面向隐式 KV 多智能体强化学习的一脑多分支架构
items.summary: Octopus is a co-designed serving runtime, memory manager and RL framework that executes long-horizon agent episodes as a GPU-resident DAG over radix cursors, with fork, rewind, read_thread, wait and done primitives for sharing and mounting KV cache. Trained on Qwen3.5-4B, it raises BrowseComp-Plus accuracy under BM25 from 26.0% with 32K ReAct and 32.1% with 143K GRPO to 49.6%, and reports a 21x reduction in cache hijacking.

items.title: Route to Remember: Adaptive Memory Selection for LLM Agents
items.title_zh: Route to Remember：面向 LLM 智能体的自适应记忆选择
items.summary: The paper applies on-policy self-distillation to train a context-free student from the same model conditioned on a user's memory, making weight memory competitive as a long-term factual store, and adds a verify-then-regenerate router that sends each query to weight or text memory. On HaluMem, it matches or surpasses strong text-memory baselines while reading fewer tokens per query.

items.title: SlackBench: Benchmarking Agents on Collaborative Projects Grounded in Real Code Repositories
items.title_zh: SlackBench：在真实代码仓库协作项目中评估智能体
items.summary: SlackBench is a benchmark of 140 queries built from privacy-preserving reenactments of real academic research projects, requiring agents to search multi-party dialogue, inspect evolving GitHub repositories and Google Docs, reconcile stale or conflicting evidence, and abstain on unanswerable questions. Across 33 frontier models and agent harnesses, the best system scores around 80% and most agents fall below 66%.

items.title: Tencent Hunyuan's Hyra 2.0 Research Agent Builds Its Own Tools for Proteins, Proofs and Chips
items.title_zh: 腾讯混元 Hyra 2.0 研究智能体为蛋白质、定理证明和芯片自建工具
items.summary: Tencent Hunyuan's Hyra 2.0 research agent builds reusable tools, including a protein design model reported to be 57x faster, force fields, a new quantum code and mathematical results on Petty and Yau.

items.title: On the Generalization Limitation of On-Policy Distillation for Post-RL Consolidation
items.title_zh: 论策略内蒸馏在后强化学习能力巩固中的泛化局限
items.summary: The paper finds that on-policy distillation and multi-teacher on-policy distillation can reach 96.04-102.73% of teachers' in-distribution scores on extrapolative tasks while scoring 2.45-16.25% below the base model out of distribution, and that compositional OOD performance remains 18.19-24.34% below the best teachers. It examines teacher capability and data coverage as bottlenecks and proposes geometry-based patching and base-preserving replay.

items.title: Adversarial Speculative Reasoning Improves Long Horizon Agents
items.title_zh: 对抗式投机推理提升长程智能体
items.summary: The authors argue that speculative decoding is not behavior-neutral for long-horizon agents, because numerical noise within verification windows can shift the output distribution after 30 steps. They train draft models to be rejected at critical reasoning points so those tokens are sampled from the target model, and report higher end-to-end success on agentic coding benchmarks by training 0.06-0.28% of hosted parameters without changing the target model.

items.title: Iterated creation, grading, and revision of data science projects by language models
items.title_zh: 语言模型对数据科学项目的迭代创建、评分与修订
items.summary: The study runs 147 initial data-science project submissions from seven models across five developers through three rounds of writer grading and revision; 107 run and render, and average scores rise from 59% to 76%. It finds that self-grading tends to be about 9 percentage points above peer scores and that weaker models generally do not improve stronger ones when acting as graders.

items.title: KKKKhazix/agent-autoloop
items.title_zh: agent-autoloop：让命令行 Agent 在后台自主接活并跟进
items.summary: agent-autoloop is a TypeScript tool that lets command-line agents pick up work in the background and follow through, interrupting the user with a card only when a decision is needed.

items.title: Agentic cheminformatics with Google Antigravity
items.title_zh: 借助 Google Antigravity 的智能体化学信息学
items.summary: Google DeepMind describes how Google Antigravity and its Cheminformatics Skills accelerate drug-discovery workflows, search compounds and propose novel rigidified macrocycles.
